· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 진입 조건 (RSI 30 이하 회복 및 5일 저가 지지 확인)
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1.08) vs SMA5/20/50 ($1.08/$1.10/$1.11) — below short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($1.23/$1.37) — below long-term trends.
· 52-week position (2.8%) + current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.0→44.2) + neutral assessment + downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0026→-0.0024) + holding steady worsening assessment + no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $1.10) + 7.84% band width indicating normal levels.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.06) + basis (Pivot S1 $1.03, 5-day low $1.05 based).
· Swing resistance ($1.13) + significance of breakout (SMA50, Bollinger upper band).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low = 20-day low) + sideways trend interpretation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.26x) + normal confidence level for price movement.
· Current phase assessment (Accumulation phase) + entry condition (RSI recovery below 30 and confirmation of 5-day low support).
